versions.content:
[SWS_CM_10390] Configuration of a data accumulation on a Required- SomeipServiceInstance for transmission over UDP
⌈
For
a
Required-
SomeipServiceInstance all method requests for which the udpCollection-
Trigger is set to never shall be aggregated in a buffer until a trigger arrives that
starts the data transmission.
The following trigger options shall be supported:
• a SOME/IP message needs to be transmitted for which the udpCollection-
Trigger is set to always.
• the udpCollectionBufferTimeout is reached for one of the SOME/IP mes-
sage already aggregated in the buffer.
• the buffer size defined by the attribute udpCollectionBufferSizeThresh-
old is reached.
• adding the method request or event to the buffer would lead to a message
larger than the maximum possible size (e.g. MTU size). In this case the actual
buffer shall be triggered before handling the new event or method response.
⌋
